items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: in New Jersey I worked with a guy named Grover Kemble

ctx.x: What are you nuts? Five sharps? We don’t do that. Well you’ve always had a gift of gab and that’s a compliment. And I’ve wondered, Bucky was not very verbose. He let his music speak. Did the early rock & roll experience you had help you get comfortable on stage interacting with the audience?

No you know actually in New Jersey I worked with a guy named Grover Kemble. And Grover was a — still is, is like a Jersey presence. He was a guy who’d go out and play the guitar and he would constantly egg the band on, I mean egg the audience on. And it was always so interesting. I’m just going to turn that off there so we don’t get anymore dings.
I’m going to turn off something here myself, hold on.
